label: Eleos system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an Eleos locus represented by LeoA, LeoB, LeoBC, and LeoC profiles that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Eleos branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual leoA, leoB, or leoC genes, LeoA, LeoB, or LeoC proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Eleos locus, unresolved Eleos trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
